issues.detail: The Greek 'εξετραπησαν' (exetrapēsan) means 'turned away' or 'were turned back'. The Vietnamese 'xây bỏ' (abandoned/gave up) changes the action from a change of direction/turning back to a cessation of an activity. Furthermore, 'οπισω του σατανα' means 'behind Satan' (following behind him), whereas the Vietnamese 'để theo Sa-tan' suggests a purpose ('in order to follow').
